Hymn 27: Praise to the Man
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Scottish folk song
Lyricist/Text Author: William W. Phelps
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 27 titled "Praise to the Man" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Scottish folk song and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
